# Agent reference (generated by `sandloom generate`; never edit)

Read the matching section before opening a registry, a CI config or a kernel entry point. Source: `tools/agent_reference.py`.

## 1. Registries (shared files: never open whole, never reorder others' lines)

Add only your own lines; the orchestrator resolves merge conflicts. Find
neighbours with `grep -n`, read 20 lines around the hit.

**guarantees.yml** (G-/C- ledger; page `docs/reference/guarantees.md` is generated)
```yaml
- id: G-TENANT-01
  statement: <one sentence, behaviour that must never weaken>
  sources: [docs/modules/database/multi-tenancy.md]
  tests: [src/sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_isolation.py::test_no_tenant_bound_fails_closed]
```
Other enforcement keys: `rules:` (`sandloom check` rule), `import_contracts:`; none ->
`gap` + `gap_size` (S/M/L). New id: also bump `issued:` (never reuse an id; dropping one
needs `removed:` with approved_by). New ADR heading: `adr_sections:`. Top keys:
`grep -n '^[a-z_]*:' guarantees.yml`; neighbours: `grep -n 'id: G-TENANT' guarantees.yml`.
Gate: `uv run python tools/checks/guarantees.py check`; then `... render` rewrites the page;
`... show G-TENANT-01` prints one entry.

**tests/architecture/kernel_edges.yml** (live kernel-edge register, SANDLOOM-T017) and
**design/kernel-boundary/edges.yml** (the design copy; same ids, kind, class, target, adr,
anchors, current_status, compared by `test_kernel_edges.py`; its `summary:` counts must match)
```yaml
  - id: B-N20
    kind: documentation          # runtime when absent
    class: b
    type: naming
    scope: runtime
    owner: tenancy
    baseline_verdict: allowed
    current_status: retained     # open | fixed | retained; fixed needs a literal anchor
    target: retained
    adr: ADR-0012
    reason: docstring example    # required when retained
    prs: [KB-03]
    anchors:
      - {path: sandloom/core/contract_cache_shadow.py, literal: tenancy.membership.v1}
```
A PR that carries a row to its target flips `current_status` in both files. Rows:
`grep -n '^  - id: ' <file>`; neighbours: `grep -n -A3 'id: B-S' <file>`. Check:
`uv run python tests/architecture/kernel_edges.py --report --base origin/arch/kernel-boundary`.

**src/sandloom/core/error_codes.py** (`CATALOGUE`; page `docs/reference/error-codes.md` is generated)
```python
    _entry(
        "SANDLOOM-T016", "declared-generated-file", "test",   # code, slug, kind
        "<title>", "<fix, one line>",
        """<explain: what happened, why, how to fix>""",
        docs="docs/admin-console/add-your-module.md",
    ),
```
Newest first at the top of the tuple, but not strictly by number: list codes with
`grep -n '^        "SANDLOOM-T' src/sandloom/core/error_codes.py`, take the next free
number, never reuse or renumber. Then `uv run python tools/docs/docs_reference.py` (page;
`--check` verifies) and `uv run sandloom explain SANDLOOM-T016`.

**tools/packaging/public-source.json** (every tracked file is classified)
`include` = `[{"reason": ..., "paths": [exact paths]}]`, then `exclude_files` / `exclude_trees`
(`{path: reason}`), `symlinks`. Example line in the tests group:
`"tests/architecture/test_docs_generated.py",`. A new file goes into the group whose
reason fits, next to its siblings (`grep -n '"tests/architecture/test_d' tools/packaging/public-source.json`);
owner-local files go to `exclude_files`. Check: `python3 tools/packaging/export_repository.py --check`.

**public_api_baseline.json** (`{module: {name: {kind, members, signature}}}`, SANDLOOM-T008)
```json
"sandloom.core.contract_testing": { "ContractConformanceError": { "kind": "class",
  "members": ["add_note", "args", "with_traceback"], "signature": null } }
```
Never hand-edit. `uv run python tools/packaging/check_public_api.py` is the gate,
`... --update` rewrites it; a new public name is an API decision (upgrade steps in the
CHANGELOG). Find a module: `grep -n '^  "sandloom\.sdk' public_api_baseline.json`.

**CHANGELOG.md**: a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in `### Breaking changes`, `### Security`,
`### Added`, `### Changed` or `### Fixed` (`grep -n '^### ' CHANGELOG.md | head -6`).

## 2. CI by path (a path in the filter runs the area's jobs; `ci-required` needs them all)

Omitted from the globs: `.github/**`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `tools/packaging/**/*.py` repeats.
Local runner: `tools/ci/ci_local.py --list`; local gates: `uv run sandloom test <module>`.
Full-validation only (not per PR): app-recipes, app-split, backend-tests-isolation, microservices-smoke, quickstart.
Always: `workflow-policy`: python3 tools/packaging/sync_release.py ; python3 tools/packaging/export_repository.py --check ; python3 tools/checks/check_secrets.py

**admin**: tools/inspection/** admin/** src/** tools/smoke/admin_live_acceptance.py
- admin-contracts: node --test tools/inspection/test_viewer.mjs ; npm run contracts:check
- admin-ui: npm run contracts:check ; npm run format:check ; npm run lint ; npm run build ; npm test ; npm run build-storybook ; npm run audit ; npm run test:browser ; npm run test:live ; python3 scripts/smoke-container.py

**architecture**: src/** tests/** packages/** tools/checks/** tools/packaging/*.py docs/adr/** docs/reference/guarantees.md
- architecture: uv run python tools/checks/check_architecture.py ; uv run python tools/packaging/check_public_api.py ; uv run pytest src/sandloom/core/tests/test_architecture.py -q

**backend**: src/** tests/** tools/ci/** tools/smoke/** migrations/** packages/** tools/checks/** tools/packaging/*.py conftest.py architecture_rules.yml guarantees.yml .env.test
- backend-static: uv run ruff check --no-fix src/ ; python3 tools/checks/check_secrets.py ; uv run ruff format --check src/ ; uv run mypy src/ ; uv run pytest tests/architecture/ -q --no-cov -p no:cacheprovider ; uv run python tools/checks/check_architecture.py ; uv run python tools/packaging/check_public_api.py ; uv run python tools/packaging/check_wheel_rpc_transport.py
- supply-chain: tools/checks/supply_chain.sh all
- backend-tests: uv run pytest -q -n auto --dist loadfile --durations=25 -p sandloom.core.testing.skip_ledger --sa...
- kernel-without-batteries: .venv-kernel/bin/python tools/ci/no_batteries.py check ; .venv-kernel/bin/python -m pytest -q -n auto --dist loadfile --durations=25 --sandloom-shuffle=ra...
- second-db-test-lane: uv run pytest -q -n auto --dist loadfile --durations=15 --sandloom-shuffle=random -m "not slow" -... ; uv run pytest -q -n auto --dist loadfile --durations=10 --sandloom-shuffle=random -m "not slow" -... ; python3 tools/smoke/quickstart_check.py --database sqlite --profile standard --redis-url redis://...
- skip-ledger: python3 tools/ci/skip_ledger.py skip-ledger/*.json --allowlist tools/ci/skip_ledger_allowlist.jso...

**benchmarks**: benchmarks/** tools/checks/check_benchmark_dependencies.py
- benchmarks-security: uv run --frozen python tools/checks/check_benchmark_dependencies.py ; uv run --frozen pytest -c pyproject.toml benchmarks/tests/test_harness_loadclient.py benchmarks/t... ; uv run --frozen pytest -c pyproject.toml benchmarks/tests --ignore=benchmarks/tests/test_harness_...

**dependency_review**: packages/**/pyproject.toml benchmarks/pyproject.toml benchmarks/uv.lock benchmarks/ladder/cg/requirements.txt admin/package-lock.json admin/package.json examples/**

**deploy**: deploy/** .dockerignore
- deploy-profiles: docker compose -f deploy/compose/monolith.yml config --quiet ; docker compose -f deploy/compose/microservices.yml config --quiet ; deploy/observability/check.sh

**docs**: docs/** examples/** website/** LICENSE NOTICE tools/docs/** zensical.toml src/** **/AGENTS.md **/CLAUDE.md **/README.md .claude/** deploy/** benchmarks/dx/**
- docs: python3 tools/docs/docs_stale_symbols.py ; python3 tools/docs/docs_prose_lint.py ; uv run --locked python tools/docs/docs_code_check.py ; python3 tools/docs/docs_site.py build ; uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tools/docs -p test_docs_site.py

**examples**: examples/** docs/getting-started/tutorial.md tools/smoke/tutorial_check.py
